_about: The art palette of Tre: flat colors from the natural pigments of Đông Hồ prints. All SVG art and all UI colors use only these colors. styles/palette.css and src/render/palette.js have the same values; a test checks this.
_shadesAbout: The side faces of raised ground, for the code only: for a top color, a lit tone (the face that looks to the screen left) and a dark tone (the face that looks to the screen right). Each is the top color mixed with ink (18 and 36 percent). Three flat tones for each color, no gradients.
